question: What is the meaning of social life cycle assessment (slca) in relation to chemical properties?
description: Social Life Cycle Assessment (SLCA) is a method used to analyze the social and sociological aspects of products, such as human rights, working conditions, and governance. It focuses on human well-being and is a relatively new method compared to current environmental assessment methods. SLCA is not as advanced and only a limited number of studies are available. It is not directly related to chemical properties but rather to social and sociological aspects of products. Materials passports can be used to provide relevant information for SLCA but are not directly related to chemical properties.
